rewrites.comment: Neither the XRPL testnet JSON-RPC endpoint nor the TEE extension proxy sends CORS headers, so a browser fetch straight to either is blocked. Vite's dev server proxies these paths locally; these rewrites do the same job in production so the deployed app can read XRPL and talk to the enclave. Both must come before the SPA catch-all.
Client-side routing: every other path is served index.html so react-router can resolve it.
